features.title: Normalised hook event and the Claude adapter
criteria: The normalised event (kinds, session id, turn id, continuation flag, round, cwd, normalised tool name and input) is documented in plugins/proof/docs/agents.md
session-start, gate, wrap and admit read the normalised event and write a normalised result
plugins/proof/scripts/agents/claude.mjs translates Claude Code stdin/stdout to and from it
tests/agents.sh exists, validates fixtures against the shape and fails on a fixture without a source field
Claude Code hook outputs are unchanged for the same inputs
features.verify: bash tests/run.sh passes with no existing test edited; tests/agents.sh claude fixtures match and the source-field check fails on a fixture missing it
features.evidence: bash tests/agents.sh: 8 passed (13 Claude fixtures, no-source rejected, scripts read through hookInput, unknown agent falls back); bash tests/run.sh all passed with no existing test edited; verifier compared every output path with HEAD

features.title: Spike: continuing a turn in opencode and Gemini CLI
criteria: A scratch opencode plugin sends one prompt through client.session.prompt on session.idle and opencode acts on it
A Gemini CLI AfterAgent block makes the agent retry once; a BeforeTool hook rewrites one shell command
Both: the follow-up proof sent can be told apart from a new user prompt
features.verify: manual run of each in a scratch project; result and versions recorded in the SPEC decision log
features.evidence: opencode part done (SPEC decision log 2026-11-03); Gemini CLI not signed in, not tested

features.title: Round counting owned by proof
criteria: The gate counts rounds from the normalised turn id and continuation flag for every agent
After maxRounds failing rounds the turn ends with the ask-the-user message; a fresh user prompt resets the count
features.verify: tests/agents.sh drives maxRounds + 1 failing turn ends through the claude adapter and a stub adapter with no prompt_id; rounds 1..maxRounds continue, the next stops
features.evidence: bash tests/rounds.sh 20 passed: bare turn ends plus every adapter (claude, opencode, gemini, codex, cursor, grok, antigravity) — rounds 1-3 sent back, the 4th let through, a new prompt starts at round 1

features.title: Capability table
criteria: plugins/proof/docs/agents.md has one row per agent, one column per behaviour, event kind, skills, subagents and tested-live status
Each cell is yes (hook name), no or unknown; each yes has a fixture
features.verify: tests/agents.sh table check: a row per installer agent, valid cells, a fixture per yes
features.evidence: bash tests/agents.sh "the capability table" cases: docs table equals install.mjs --table, a row per agent, valid cells, a fixture per yes

features.title: Rules text per agent
criteria: rules.md renders for each agent with that agent's names for background waits, the verifier and skills
No Claude-only tool name appears in a non-Claude render
features.verify: tests/agents.sh rules case renders every agent and greps for Claude-only names
features.evidence: bash tests/agents.sh "rules per agent": Claude render equals tests/fixtures/rules-claude.md; no Claude-only names in the 6 other renders

features.title: Skills and subagents per agent
criteria: Skills render with resolved paths, no ${CLAUDE_*}, no !` injection, no TaskOutput or claude -p
Quick mode takes its session id from the normalised event
verifier and screen-judge install as subagents where the agent has them, else as skills
features.verify: tests/agents.sh installs for each agent into a scratch folder and greps installed skill files; quick mode turned on through a non-Claude adapter is seen by the gate; installed paths checked
features.evidence: bash tests/agents.sh "install and uninstall" (no Claude-only names in any installed skill or subagent; verifier and screen-judge installed) and "quick mode through an agent without a session id" (2 passed)

features.title: Shared data folder
criteria: Every proof process uses PROOF_DATA_DIR, else the folder the installer resolved, written into each agent's config
features.verify: tests/dashboard.sh case: Claude and opencode fixture sessions started from separate processes with no shared env both appear in one monitor's data.json
features.evidence: bash tests/dashboard.sh "the monitor lists Claude and other agents' sessions together, from one data folder": an opencode session written by hooks in an env -i process with only --data appears beside a Claude session

features.title: Event log writer and schema
criteria: Adapters append session start, user prompt, tool start/end, turn end, gate run and waiting events to <data folder>/events/<agent>/<session>.jsonl
The schema is documented in plugins/proof/docs/agents.md
features.verify: tests/agents.sh scripted session through each adapter, event file checked line by line against the schema
features.evidence: bash tests/agents.sh "a scripted session through each adapter writes the event log": 18 passed (all 6 agents, schema checked line by line)

features.title: Timeline and monitor read the event log
criteria: The timeline builds the same session model from an event log as from a Claude transcript, except token counts and model thinking
The monitor lists event-log sessions from the last day and keeps the Mac awake while one is working
A session with no event for 10 minutes and no live gate run counts as stopped
features.verify: timeline comparison test with an event-log fixture hand-built from the Claude transcript fixture; tests/dashboard.sh cases for a mixed Claude + opencode data.json and a stale truncated log
features.evidence: bash tests/dashboard.sh: event log and Claude transcript of one session compared field by field (and a planted difference caught); truncated log quiet 39 min not working; mixed data.json

features.title: Gate ledger and catch counting
criteria: Every gate run that ran or reused a check appends one line to ~/.config/proof/ledger.jsonl (or PROOF_LEDGER), no output stored
A catch is fail then pass on different code in the same session; same code is flaky
features.verify: bash tests/ledger.sh
features.evidence: bash tests/ledger.sh: 45 passed (ledger lines, catch/flaky/revert/asked-user/machine-memory cases); bash tests/run.sh all passed
